digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — outbound comments and parent-drift breadcrumb
propositions: In the live-search path, when a snapshot lacks the comment field and a child has zero local comments, the parent-drift breadcrumb is not emitted because _diff_comments early-returns before _build_parent_breadcrumb is reached.

A drift-affected bound child with zero local comments should receive exactly one parent-drift breadcrumb in the live-search path via live-fetched comment set append-once dedup, but currently receives none.

The fix requires extracting the Jira-comment-set resolution and breadcrumb-target logic into helper functions (_snapshot_comment_set, _live_comment_set, _breadcrumb_target) to avoid exceeding McCabe complexity ceiling in _diff_comments.

When _breadcrumb_target indicates a breadcrumb may apply, the live-search path must fetch comments even with zero local comments; client-None and fetch-failure must still return empty (bug-4292 unknown-state safety).
